profile.name: Daniel Okafor
profile.subline: New-grad ML engineer and applied scientist roles for a December 2026 Columbia MS graduate · Tailored to your September 2026 resume
profile.recentRole: Bloomberg — Software Engineer Intern · Columbia — Research Assistant, LLM Evaluation
profile.stack: Python, PyTorch, Hugging Face Transformers, C++, SQL, AWS, Spark
profile.target: New Grad FT · NYC / Remote · ML Engineer + Applied Scientist
profile.summary: Position yourself as an ML engineer who has already shipped in a finance codebase: the Bloomberg internship plus your LLM-evaluation research is a rare pairing that NYC banks, quant shops and the AI labs' New York offices all want. Home base is New York, so this board was re-mapped around Manhattan: Utah-only employers drop to far, the multi-office firms are scored on their NYC presence, and a dozen New York employers were added. Keep the top labs as reaches and let the bank and fintech new-grad programs, most of which are live now, carry the first month.

profile.applyNow: **Bloomberg first**: you interned there, so ask your manager for a return-offer conversation before the 2027 Engineering req is even posted, then submit through the board the day it opens. This week also hit **Goldman Sachs 2027 New Analyst (Engineering)**, **Stripe New Grad SWE** (NYC hybrid, degree by summer 2027 qualifies you) and **JPMorgan's Software Engineer Program / DSAI Associate**, all live in New York.
profile.watchLater: Datadog's early-career reqs post in September for a spring class that fits a December grad, and Anthropic and OpenAI new-grad and residency posts appear without warning, so check both weekly through November. Capital One's TDP has a February 2027 start if a Virginia relocation is on the table.

companies.name: MX Technologies
companies.why: **Utah-only and senior-only right now.** Fintech with real AI insights work, but every engineering req is Staff-level and on-site in Lehi, with no remote and no new-grad track. Only worth a look if you would relocate for a smaller fintech, which is not your stated plan.

companies.name: Goldman Sachs (SLC Campus)
companies.note: The 2027 New Analyst reqs in Engineering are live with eligibility from December 2026 through July 2027 graduates, and the same req family covers the New York headquarters, so apply to the NYC seat this week; it fills on a rolling basis.
companies.why: **Headquartered in Manhattan, and the 2027 Engineering analyst class is live.** This board entry tracks the Salt Lake campus, but the same req family hires into 200 West Street, where GS AI Platform and Marquee teams sit. Your Bloomberg C++/Python internship is the profile they take straight into engineering.

companies.name: Recursion Pharmaceuticals
companies.why: **Real ML-for-drug-discovery work, but Salt Lake City on-site.** Every live req is senior computational biology and nothing is remote, so this only fits if you would relocate to Utah for an AI-biotech, which is a stretch against your NYC-or-top-lab plan.

companies.name: Domo
companies.why: **Weak fit.** A BI vendor in Utah County with one open req company-wide, no ML hiring and no remote engineering. Your PyTorch and LLM work has no surface here; skip it.

companies.name: Qualtrics
companies.why: **Provo/Seattle only, nothing entry-level today.** Qualtrics does have text-analytics and ML teams, and your NLP research is relevant, but the live Provo reqs are sales and finance, and new-grad SWE hiring is Provo or Seattle on-site. Watch, do not prioritize.

companies.name: Ataccama
companies.note: All 17 live reqs are Prague, Toronto or London, or senior and sales roles in the US, so there is nothing entry-level stateside today; their US team is in Boston, and only a cold note would get you in.
companies.why: **Data-quality vendor with no US entry door.** Their AI data-quality platform is interesting, but you have no Ataccama experience and their US presence is a small Boston team with nothing junior posted. Low priority for an ML-focused search.

companies.name: Sigma Computing
companies.why: **New Grad Program is on-site SF or New York, so the NYC seat is within reach.** Cloud BI with an AI copilot; the work is SWE and data engineering rather than ML, so it is a solid fallback rather than a target. Apply the week you graduate, since they require graduation within the past 12 months.

companies.name: Adobe (Lehi Campus)
companies.why: **This entry is Lehi-specific.** Adobe runs Firefly and Sensei ML teams, but they sit in San Jose and Seattle, and the Lehi analyst reqs are far from your ML target. Track Adobe's 2027 University Graduate ML reqs directly rather than through the Utah site.

companies.name: Ancestry
companies.why: **Large consumer ML problem, wrong geography.** Genealogy matching at scale is genuinely interesting ML, but hiring is Lehi on-site, the live Associate SWE req reads like a PERM posting, and there is no remote ML door. A stretch unless you would move to Utah.

companies.name: Pluralsight
companies.why: **Weak fit.** Draper-based learning platform with zero Utah reqs and nothing entry-level; its AI skills features are not an ML engineering org. Nothing here for a Columbia ML grad in New York.

companies.name: Health Catalyst
companies.why: **Healthcare analytics in Utah, junior DevOps only.** The single US junior req is DevOps in Salt Lake City and their analyst hiring has moved to India. No ML engineering path and no remote option for you.

companies.name: Galileo Financial Technologies
companies.why: **Fintech infrastructure, but nothing technical or entry-level is posted.** Galileo now hires through SoFi's board and the live reqs are finance roles in Utah. Your fintech angle is better served by SoFi's own NYC office or the banks.

companies.name: Lucid Software
companies.why: **Real new-grad SWE program, but South Jordan on-site.** Lucid has a genuine College Grad SWE req that drops in fall and an AI diagram-generation team; it is still Utah-only, so this is a stretch that only makes sense if you would relocate for a mid-size SaaS company.

companies.name: Weave
companies.note: The live Fraud Analyst req at their Lehi headquarters asks for beginner-to-intermediate SQL plus Snowflake and Sigma reporting; it is an on-site Utah analyst role, not an engineering one.
companies.why: **On-site Utah analyst hiring, not ML.** Weave applies AI to SMB communication, but the only live entry req is a Lehi fraud analyst built around SQL and Sigma reporting. Nothing here uses your PyTorch or research background.

companies.name: Podium
companies.why: **Generative AI is core to the product, but every engineering req is Senior/Staff and Lehi-based.** Worth an alert for an ML Engineer I posting if you would relocate; otherwise nothing to do today.

companies.name: Snowflake
companies.why: **Snowflake has a sizable New York office, and Cortex is a real LLM platform team.** No 2027 University Graduate req yet, and live SWE reqs want 2+ years, but their year-round general SWE match program is open. Your Spark and SQL work makes you a credible data-platform hire while you wait for ML reqs.

companies.name: Databricks
companies.why: **Mosaic AI and a growing New York office.** The live New Grad APM req is product, not ML, and sits in Bellevue, Mountain View or SF; the reason to apply is their new-grad SWE and ML reqs that historically follow in fall. Your LLM-evaluation research is a direct match for the Mosaic evaluation tooling.

companies.name: Plaid
companies.why: **NYC office plus ML for fraud and income verification.** No new-grad req yet, but Plaid's university cycle posts each fall for SF and New York. A Bloomberg intern with Python and ML depth is the profile they take into risk-modeling teams.

companies.name: Stripe
companies.why: **New Grad SWE is live, hybrid New York, and a degree by summer 2027 qualifies you.** Radar is a serious ML fraud org. Apply this week; Stripe fills cohorts fast, and a Bloomberg internship plus an ML thesis is exactly the resume their New York office shortlists.

companies.name: Brex
companies.why: **Brex has a New York office and AI expense agents, but the live AI Engineer and Data Engineer reqs are mid-level in SF and Seattle.** No new-grad track today; set a Greenhouse alert and apply only if an AI Engineer I posting appears for NYC.

companies.name: SoFi
companies.why: **SoFi runs a New York office alongside the Utah one.** Nothing new-grad is posted and the live technical reqs want 5+ years, so join their University Recruiting community and re-check monthly. AI underwriting is the relevant team if a junior ML role appears.

companies.name: Instructure (Canvas)
companies.why: **EdTech with ML in Budapest and accounting in Salt Lake City.** The live SLC reqs are SDR and finance; engineering hiring for AI features happens abroad. No path for you here.

companies.name: Filevine
companies.why: **Legal AI, but the remote opening is a product role.** Associate Product Manager on LOIS is US remote and live; it is not an ML engineering seat, though it shows the company is building LLM products. Apply only if product interests you as a backup.

companies.name: BambooHR
companies.why: **Weak fit.** Utah HR software with Senior/Staff-only data and engineering reqs and no remote ML work. Skip.

companies.name: Vivint Smart Home
companies.why: **Weak fit.** Provo-based, hiring through NRG's board, and the live reqs are ops, sales or 3+ years engineering. Its security-analytics ML is small and on-site in Utah.

companies.name: Pattern
companies.why: **Ecommerce analytics in Lehi, nothing entry-level in data or ML.** The Data Engineer req looks stale and the live reqs are senior finance and PM. No remote engineering door.

companies.name: Entrata
companies.why: **Weak fit.** Property-management SaaS in Lehi whose SWE and Data Scientist reqs are years old. Nothing for a New York ML candidate.

companies.name: Nav Technologies
companies.why: **Small SMB-credit fintech with no current openings.** Their Greenhouse board says there are no positions; even when it reopens, hiring is Utah-centric. Skip for now.

companies.name: Cotiviti
companies.why: **Remote-US analyst roles, but not engineering.** Payment Insight Analyst I is genuinely entry-level and remote, yet it is a healthcare-data analyst seat rather than ML. A safety-net application at most; the South Jordan engineering reqs want 5+ years.

companies.name: JPMorgan Chase
companies.note: Both 2027 programs are open with a November 5 deadline and rolling fill. The Data and AI Analyst track takes December 2026 through August 2027 graduates with no prior experience required, and New York is a listed location for the Software Engineer Program.
companies.why: **Headquartered in Manhattan with the largest financial-AI research group anywhere.** JPMorgan AI Research publishes on LLM evaluation, which is your research area, and the Software Engineer Program and DSAI Associate track both hire December 2026 grads into New York. Your Bloomberg internship makes the finance-plus-ML story credible.

companies.name: Capital One
companies.why: **Strong ML org and a live TDP for February 2027, but the seats are McLean, Richmond or Plano.** Capital One keeps a New York office, yet the development programs are not placed there and there is no remote option. A strong fallback if you would relocate to Virginia; their Applied Research teams do hire MS grads.

companies.name: Mastercard
companies.note: Launch 2027 Software Engineer is live for December 2026 through June 2027 graduates and lists a Salt Lake City seat at $100K; the same program places engineers at Mastercard's New York tech hub and Purchase, NY headquarters, so pick the New York location. A Data Scientist I req is open too.
companies.why: **Headquartered in Purchase, NY with a big Manhattan tech hub, and Launch 2027 is live.** AI fraud detection at Mastercard's scale is real applied-ML work. Apply for the New York seat rather than Salt Lake City; the 18-month rotation fits an MS grad who wants to see multiple ML teams.

companies.name: Bloomberg
companies.note: No 2027 US new-grad Engineering, Analytics or Data req is live on their Avature board yet. Before it opens, ask your intern manager about a return offer, and join the talent community so the New York posting reaches you the day it goes up.
companies.why: **Bullseye: you already interned here, in New York.** Bloomberg's AI group built BloombergGPT and runs serious LLM-evaluation work, which is your research area, and 731 Lexington is your home base. A return-offer conversation is the fastest route to a signed offer on this board.

companies.name: OpenAI
companies.why: **Reach role at a top lab, and OpenAI now has a New York office.** No new-grad track and nothing entry-level among 767 reqs today, but a Columbia ML thesis on LLM evaluation plus Bloomberg engineering is the profile their Evals and Applied teams shortlist. Track the University Recruiting page weekly.

companies.name: Anthropic
companies.why: **Reach role, but the closest to your research.** Anthropic's evaluations and alignment work is what your RA project measures, and they opened a New York office. Nothing entry-level is live; watch for new-grad SWE and the residency, and lead with your LLM-eval papers or code when you apply.

companies.name: Scale AI
companies.why: **Evaluation and RLHF data is their business, and they have a New York office.** SWE reqs are SF/NYC mid-level with no new-grad posting, but the ICML 2026 University Recruiting talent-pool form is open and your LLM-evaluation research maps directly to their SEAL evals team. Fill the form now.

companies.name: Robinhood
companies.why: **New York office and ML features, but the live new-grad req is a business analyst role in Washington DC.** Not an ML engineering door today. Watch their board for a New Grad SWE or ML posting for the NYC office.

companies.name: Ramp
companies.note: Associate-level Strategic Finance and Credit Risk roles are live at the New York headquarters, in-office; there are no engineering entry reqs posted today, so watch for a New Grad SWE or Applied ML posting rather than applying to the finance roles.
companies.why: **NYC-headquartered, AI-native fintech that hires into its Manhattan office.** Ramp's AI accountant and underwriting products are applied-ML work, and being in-office in New York is a plus for you, not a blocker. The live reqs are finance, so this is a watch-and-pounce entry.

companies.name: Hugging Face
companies.why: **Headquartered in New York, and Transformers is on your resume.** Only five live reqs, all senior ML and infra, so the open Wild Card application is the only door. Pair it with public contributions to their evaluation libraries, which is the most direct way in for someone with your LLM-eval background.

companies.name: Perplexity AI
companies.why: **AI-native search with a New York office, but 99 reqs and nothing junior in engineering.** A stretch for a new grad; your retrieval and evaluation work is relevant if an entry ML posting appears. Track, do not spend hours on it.

companies.name: DigiCert
companies.why: **Weak fit.** PKI security in Lehi whose live entry req is a customer-facing authentication analyst role. No ML, no remote engineering, no New York presence.

companies.name: Ivanti
companies.why: **Weak fit.** Endpoint security in South Jordan with a tiny board and no entry roles. Nothing here for an ML engineer.

companies.name: Proofpoint
companies.why: **ML threat detection is real, but engineering hiring is India and remote-senior.** The Draper reqs are sales and IT support, so this Utah-centered entry does not help you. Proofpoint's Sunnyvale ML teams are a different search.

companies.name: SecurityMetrics
companies.why: **Weak fit.** Orem compliance auditors and support roles, hiring from Utah County schools. No ML work and no reason for a New York candidate to apply.

companies.name: Arctic Wolf
companies.why: **Security operations, not ML engineering.** Their new-grad doors are Triage Security Analyst and Concierge Security in Utah or Minnesota, with zero entry US reqs live. Not your target role.

companies.name: CrowdStrike
companies.note: The New Grad Data Scientist req requires an MS or PhD, which your Columbia degree satisfies, and CrowdStrike is remote-first; the Analyst I Falcon Complete SOC role is the other entry ladder but is not an ML seat.
companies.why: **Remote-first with a New Grad Data Scientist req that explicitly wants an MS.** Falcon's detection models are AI-native security ML, and the role is remote from New York. Your PyTorch and evaluation work fits; the security domain is new to you, so expect that question in interviews.

companies.name: Palo Alto Networks
companies.why: **Precision AI across the platform and a New York office, but no US new-grad SWE req.** The Associate Systems Engineer track is APAC and Texas only. Watch for ML reqs in Santa Clara or New York; a stretch for this season.

companies.name: Okta
companies.why: **Remote-first identity company, but the new-grad SWE class is SF, Chicago, Bellevue and DC.** Identity is not an ML domain and no 2027 req is live. Low priority for you.

companies.name: Cloudflare
companies.why: **Workers AI and a New York office, plus a new-grad SWE program.** No 2027 new-grad req yet; the nearest live fit is an Austin Systems Engineer on the data team. A reasonable backup for a Columbia CS grad, though not an ML-first employer.

companies.name: Datadog
companies.note: Datadog states that early-career full-time reqs post in September and fill on a rolling basis, and their spring start class fits a December graduate. New York is headquarters, so watch the early-careers page daily this month.
companies.why: **Headquartered in Manhattan with one of the largest new-grad engineering classes in the city.** Their Bits AI and anomaly-detection teams hire ML engineers, and early-career reqs post this month for a spring start that fits a December grad. Your Bloomberg C++ and Python work is exactly their systems-plus-ML profile.

companies.name: Vanta
companies.note: The live GTM Strategy and Operations Analyst req is remote-US and analyst-level at a GRC company; it is not an engineering or ML role.
companies.why: **Compliance automation with a New York office, but the live role is a GTM analyst.** Vanta is building AI agents and has a new-grad-friendly culture; still, nothing technical and junior is posted. Watch for a New Grad SWE req in NYC.

companies.name: Coalition
companies.why: **Cyber insurance is an underrated ML domain, and Coalition has a New York office.** The remote Data Engineer, Security req wants insurance and security exposure you do not have, so it is a stretch. Watch for a junior data-science or risk-modeling req.

companies.name: Sardine
companies.why: **Behavior-based fraud ML, remote-US, and your Bloomberg fintech background helps.** The live Fraud Intelligence Data Analyst req asks for 3-5 years, so nothing fits today. Watch for an associate ML or data-science req; the domain is a natural extension of your finance work.

companies.name: Wiz
companies.why: **Wiz is headquartered in New York and now part of Google.** The nearest live req is a DC threat-intel analyst with no new-grad track, so it is a name to keep warm rather than a current application. Your ML profile fits their detection teams if an entry req appears.

companies.name: Abnormal AI
companies.why: **AI-native email security, remote-first, with weekly new reqs.** The live remote roles are compliance and sales ops priced for experienced hires, not ML. Watch for a junior ML or detection-engineering post; your NLP work is relevant to their models.

companies.name: Zions Bancorporation
companies.note: Their STEM applications are accepted mid-September through November for programs based in Salt Lake City; the Banker Development Program is a rotational track for recent grads and both are on-site in Utah.
companies.why: **Salt Lake City bank with Utah-only programs.** The technology leadership program is real but on-site in SLC with no ML focus, and the New York banks on this board are far stronger fits. Skip unless relocation to Utah is on the table.

companies.name: America First Credit Union
companies.note: Postings are not on a public API, so check the careers page directly; they hire data analysts and IT staff in Riverdale, Utah, on-site.
companies.why: **Weak fit.** A Utah credit union hiring data analysts in Riverdale, on-site, with no ML surface. Nothing for a New York ML engineer.

companies.name: Verkada
companies.note: A Technical Support Engineer, University Graduate 2026 req is live plus several Associate-level operations roles; nearly everything is San Mateo in-office, so plan on relocating to the Bay Area if you apply.
companies.why: **Large computer-vision surface and a New York sales office, but engineering is San Mateo in-office.** The live university req is technical support, not ML. Apply only to a Bay Area ML or perception req if you decide a top-lab-level relocation includes Verkada, which it probably does not.

companies.name: iCapital
companies.note: 53 Utah roles are live and a Master Data Management Analyst req asks for SQL plus data governance with 2+ years; iCapital is headquartered in New York, so search their board for New York engineering and data reqs rather than the Utah analyst role.
companies.why: **New York-headquartered alternative-investments fintech.** The board entry tracks their Salt Lake City analyst hiring, but the Manhattan headquarters is where engineering and data science sit. Not an ML-first shop; a reasonable fintech fallback with your Bloomberg background.

companies.name: WGU (Western Governors University)
companies.why: **Genuine new-grad data engineering door, but Salt Lake City on-site.** The Associate Data Engineer req wants SQL, Python, ETL and Spark and counts education as experience; it is a data role at a Utah university, not ML, and would require relocation. Low priority.

suggested.name: Two Sigma
suggested.why: **Quant fund that runs like an ML lab, headquartered in SoHo.** Two Sigma hires MS grads into Quantitative Researcher and Software Engineer campus tracks, values Python and C++ from a Bloomberg-style codebase, and their research groups publish on ML. A top New York target for your profile.
suggested.note: Campus hiring runs each fall through their careers site; search for 'Quantitative Researcher - Campus' and 'Software Engineer - Campus' and apply by October, since interviews start early.

suggested.name: Jane Street
suggested.why: **Manhattan trading firm with a well-known new-grad SWE pipeline.** Jane Street hires Software Engineers and Quantitative Researchers straight from MS programs; the interviews lean on algorithms and probability more than ML, so treat it as a strong systems-engineering reach.
suggested.note: Apply through their New Grad Software Engineer and Quantitative Researcher postings on janestreet.com; they recruit year-round with a heavy fall push.

suggested.name: Google
suggested.why: **Google's New York campus is its largest engineering site outside the Bay Area, with Research and DeepMind teams on site.** New grad SWE and Research Scientist hiring covers December graduates, and a Columbia ML thesis on LLM evaluation is a direct conversation-starter for the Gemini evaluation groups.
suggested.note: Search 'Software Engineer, University Graduate' and 'Research Scientist, University Graduate' on careers.google.com, filter to New York, and apply as soon as the 2027 reqs open in September.

suggested.name: Meta
suggested.why: **Big New York office and a university ML engineer track.** Meta hires MS grads into Machine Learning Engineer, University Grad roles that use PyTorch, which they created; the New York site hosts FAIR and applied-ML teams. Competitive, but squarely in your lane.
suggested.note: Search 'Machine Learning Engineer, University Grad' and 'Software Engineer, University Grad' on metacareers.com; New York is a listed location and applications open in the fall.

suggested.name: Amazon
suggested.why: **Applied Scientist is a title Amazon actually gives new MS graduates, and New York has large Advertising and AWS AI teams.** Your AWS experience plus LLM evaluation research fits their Applied Scientist I profile; the SDE new-grad pipeline is a second door.
suggested.note: Search 'Applied Scientist' and 'Software Development Engineer' with 'University' or 'Graduate' on amazon.jobs, filtered to New York; Applied Scientist I posts want an MS, which you will have.

suggested.name: Microsoft
suggested.why: **University hiring for SWE and Applied Science, with a Times Square office.** Most new-grad seats land in Redmond, but Microsoft Research and the New York AI groups do hire MS grads, so it is a credible target rather than a sure thing for staying in the city.
suggested.note: Apply through the 'Software Engineer - University' and 'Applied Scientist - University' listings on careers.microsoft.com; location preferences are collected after the application, so ask for New York.

suggested.name: Morgan Stanley
suggested.why: **Times Square headquarters and a large Technology Analyst class for December grads.** Morgan Stanley's AI and Data teams hire into the same analyst program, and your Bloomberg internship is the kind of finance-tech signal their recruiters screen for.
suggested.note: Search 'Technology Full-Time Analyst Program' on morganstanley.com/careers; 2027 applications open in the fall and December 2026 graduates are eligible.

suggested.name: Citadel Securities
suggested.why: **Quant market maker with a formal Software Engineer and Quantitative Researcher new-grad path in New York.** Highly selective, C++ heavy, and interested in ML for pricing and execution; your Bloomberg C++ plus PyTorch is the right raw material, though the interview bar is steep.
suggested.note: Look for 'Software Engineer - Full-Time' and 'Quantitative Researcher - Full-Time' on citadelsecurities.com/careers; apply early in the fall, as slots fill on a rolling basis.

suggested.name: Hudson River Trading
suggested.why: **Lower Manhattan trading firm that hires new grads into Algorithm Developer and Software Engineer roles.** Their ML-driven strategy research is a real fit for an ML MS, but the interviews are algorithmic and low-latency systems focused. A reach with a very high ceiling.
suggested.note: Search 'Software Engineer (Full-Time)' and 'Algorithm Developer' on hudsonrivertrading.com; new-grad postings are up most of the year.

suggested.name: D. E. Shaw
suggested.why: **Midtown quant firm with dedicated ML research and software groups.** They hire MS graduates into Software Developer and Quantitative Analyst roles and are open to research-heavy resumes like yours. Less structured than a bank program, so networking with alumni helps.
suggested.note: Apply to the 'Software Developer' and 'Quantitative Analyst' generalist postings on deshaw.com/careers; there is no cohort deadline, so apply this fall.

suggested.name: Palantir
suggested.why: **Large New York office and a New Grad software track with AI platform work.** Palantir's AIP is LLM-centered, and they hire Software Engineers and Forward Deployed Engineers straight from MS programs. Less pure research than a lab, but real applied-ML shipping in the city.
suggested.note: Search 'Software Engineer, New Grad' and 'Forward Deployed Software Engineer, New Grad' on palantir.com/careers and select New York as the location.

suggested.name: Spotify
suggested.why: **Spotify's US headquarters is in Manhattan and its recommendation and ML research groups are New York based.** Entry ML hiring is thinner than at the banks and happens in waves, so this is a good-fit employer to watch rather than a guaranteed opening.
suggested.note: Watch lifeatspotify.com for 'Machine Learning Engineer' and 'Early Career' postings in New York; they also run summer internship-to-full-time conversions.

suggested.name: Runway
suggested.why: **AI-native research lab headquartered in New York, working on generative video models.** Small team with senior-leaning reqs, so an entry offer is a reach, but for someone who wants a lab without leaving the city it belongs on the list.
suggested.note: Check runwayml.com/careers for 'Research Engineer' and 'Machine Learning Engineer' postings; no formal new-grad program, so apply directly and reference public research.
